description: This file contains UI/Navigation tests for the Now in Android app using Jetpack Compose testing frameworks. It verifies navigation flows, tab states, dialog appearances, and back stack behavior within the app's main activity, focusing on test interactions with UI components such as buttons, tabs, and navigation elements.

classes.name: NavigationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class that tests navigation and UI flow within the app.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes dependency injection before each test.

methods.name: firstScreen_isForYou
methods.description: Verifies the default screen is the 'For You' tab.

methods.name: navigationBar_navigateToPreviouslySelectedTab_restoresContent
methods.description: Checks that navigation restores previously visited content when switching tabs.

methods.name: navigationBar_reselectTab_keepsState
methods.description: Ensures reselecting a tab preserves its state.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_doNotShowUpArrow
methods.description: Checks that top-level destinations do not display the up arrow.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_showTopBarWithTitle
methods.description: Verifies that the top bar displays the correct title for each destination.

methods.name: topLevelDestinations_showSettingsIcon
methods.description: Ensures the settings icon appears in the top bar for each destination.

methods.name: whenSettingsIconIsClicked_settingsDialogIsShown
methods.description: Verifies the settings dialog appears upon clicking the settings icon.

methods.name: whenSettingsDialogDismissed_previousScreenIsDisplayed
methods.description: Checks that dismissing the settings dialog restores previous content.

methods.name: homeDestination_back_quitsApp
methods.description: Expected to close the app when pressing back at the home screen.

methods.name: navigationBar_backFromAnyDestination_returnsToForYou
methods.description: Ensures back navigation from other destinations returns to the 'For You' tab.

methods.name: navigatingToTopicFromForYou_showsTopicDetails
methods.description: Tests that clicking a topic from the For You feed shows its details.
